name: OpenStock
description: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
one_liner: A free, ready-made stock-tracking website — like a stripped-down Bloomberg Terminal — that shows live prices, lets you set alerts, and shows company details.
buyer: A small independent brokerage or financial newsletter publisher who wants to offer clients a branded market-data dashboard without paying for an expensive platform license.
business_use_cases: A regional brokerage white-labels it as their client-facing portal instead of licensing an expensive vendor platform.
A financial newsletter or Discord community for retail traders offers it as a members-only alerts dashboard.
A financial advisor uses it internally as a free client-meeting screen-share tool to show live portfolio company data.

money_ideas.idea: White-label and host it for small brokerages/advisors, charging a monthly fee for hosting, branding, and support.
Add a premium alerts tier (SMS/priority alerts) on top of the free base and charge end users directly.
One-off customization projects for firms that want specific data sources or branding integrated.

steal_this: Deploy it this weekend, plug in a free market-data API, and pitch it to one local financial advisor as their new client portal for a flat setup fee.
